title: Strict-local base-change mate on global cohomology
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ a geometric point, $g:S_{(s)}\to S$ its strict-henselization map [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], $X'=X\times_S S_{(s)}$, $p:X'\to X$, and $f':X'\to S_{(s)}$. For every $K\in D^+(\operatorname{Ab}(X_{et}))$ [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories] and integer $n$, the homology of the canonical derived base-change mate [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], after strict-local global sections, is an isomorphism:
$$\Gamma(S_{(s)},H^n(g^{-1}Rf_*K))\longrightarrow\Gamma(S_{(s)},H^n(Rf'_*p^{-1}K)).$$
The mate is defined from the pullback-square inverse-image comparison by the two derived inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions. Inverse image is as in [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]; the cohomology and exact strict-local global-section identification are as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-restriction]. No assertion of invertibility as a sheaf morphism is made.

proof.text: Use [sbc-lem-higher-direct-image-presheaf] and stalk invariance under sheafification [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-geometric-stalk] to identify stalk cohomology with the neighbourhood hypercohomology colimit. The germ isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-germ-restriction-iso], and the exact inverse-image/homology comparison, identify the source with this same colimit.

Restrict to affine pointed neighbourhoods using [lemma-weil-pbc-affine-neighbourhood-cofinal]. Their limit is the strict henselization [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]; [lemma-weil-pbc-fibre-product-limit] identifies the base-changed limit. The stages are qcqs because f is qcqs and the neighbourhoods affine; transition maps are affine base changes of morphisms of affine schemes. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-derived-etale-cohomology-limit] to K with base X. It identifies this colimit with hypercohomology on X′. Exact global sections and the Leray comparison of [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-restriction] identify that hypercohomology with the target.

Choose a bounded-below injective representative [lem-weil-pbc-dplus-injective-representative]. Direct image applied to it represents Rf_*K [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. The derived adjunction mate at the complex level is restriction of sections along the pullback square. Consequently on every neighbourhood its map on H^n is exactly the projection pullback used by continuity. Equality on the germ components identifies the displayed map with the continuity isomorphism.
